summary: getComputedStyle resolution is not equivalent to reading cssRules and has CSSOM-defined exposure even when stylesheet origin-clean differs.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.cssRules_security: stylesheet cssRules has origin-clean SecurityError rules
semantics.computed_style: resolved values are exposed through its own CSSOM algorithm
semantics.ownership: do not implement by enumerating cross-origin cssRules

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: computed style is obtained from style engine

tests.name: edge
tests.expected_behavior: implementation must not require script-readable cssRules to compute resolved style
